$comment: Configs and other files modules can bring; the key is the path in the project. Each entry says where it comes from: `install` (a command; it runs when a path in `output` is missing, and those paths go when no module needs the entry any more), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits). An entry with none of these is written by another entry's `install` (listed in its `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out. A copied file has {port}, {css} and {srcDirs} replaced.

AGENTS.md.describe: tells Claude to read the Next.js docs bundled in node_modules first; `next dev` writes the same block.
